title: Synthetic SLO simulation for FP8/INT8 calibration: throughput & tail-latency under mixed batching and KV warm-up
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build a reproducible, automated SLO simulation harness that measures tokens/sec and per-token latency percentiles for FP8 and INT8 model profiles across realistic long-sequence streaming workloads. The harness must exercise mixed-size batching (1..16), KV cache cold/warm states, and microburst arrival patterns to quantify interactions between quantization-induced execution variance and batching/coalescing behavior.

Background: Previous quantization benchmarking focused on steady-state throughput and FP16 accuracy baselines but lacked tail-latency characterization under KV warm-up and mixed batching. Teams have observed intermittent p95/p99 spikes when switching to lower-precision kernels during warmup; we need objective pass/fail criteria for shipping a quant profile.

Success criteria / acceptance:
- Automated job produces a CSV and dashboard with tokens/sec, p50/p90/p95/p99 per-token latency, and accuracy delta vs FP16 (logprobs + bleu-like metric for eval prompts).
- For each profile (FP8-opt, INT8-symmetric, INT8-perchannel): report steady-state throughput, cold-start tail-latency during first 256 tokens, and long-horizon drift over 4k token scenarios.
- Thresholds: steady-state throughput >= 0.9x FP16 baseline for 8-batch; p95 <= 1.5x FP16 baseline for long-sequence runs; accuracy regression <= 0.5% aggregate on eval set.
- CI gating: profile fails if any threshold violated across two consecutive runs.

Methodology:
- Workloads: synthetic interleaved traces derived from production sampling (open prompt corpus + long-document traces) and a microburst generator (Poisson arrival + deterministic spikes).
- Batch strategy: simulate request coalescing with variable arrival windows allowing dynamic batch sizes. Include a deterministic scenario with fixed batch sizes to isolate kernel behavior.
- KV cache states: explicitly run three phases: cold (empty cache), warmup (first 512 tokens with realistic locality), and steady. Measure transitions separately.
- Calibration pipeline: run the full calibration (per-channel scale calibrators where applicable) then snapshot quant params. For each quant profile, run 5 calibration seeds and select median profile by accuracy/throughput tradeoff.
- Accuracy validation: use held-out eval set of 500 prompts (mix of short/long) and compute token-level logprob delta and downstream task metric (QA F1) to flag regressions.

Artifacts & locations:
- Design doc (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/quant-slo-sim-design
- Harness repo (internal): https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-harness/tree/eng/quant-slo-sim
- Draft dashboard (looker): https://looker.redwood.ai/dashboards/quant_slo_sim

Notes / constraints: need access to dedicated GPUs for determinism (same driver/kernel combos). Some older INT8 kernels show non-deterministic microsecond jitter; working with runtime team to pin kernel selection.
comments: 2025-02-15 Maya Chen: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded to design doc. Agreed on primary metrics and initial pass/fail thresholds. Decided synthetic traces should be seeded from 1% of production logs (anonymized).

2025-02-19 Ravi Patel: PoC harness committed in bench-harness repo (branch eng/quant-slo-sim). Initial synthetic trace generator added, supports Poisson microbursts and fixed-window coalescing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-harness/pull/128

2025-02-21 Diego Alvarez (review): Reviewed PoC. Observations: FP8 kernels on A100 show 12% steady throughput uplift vs INT8 but p99 spikes during warmup. Suggested adding deterministic cold-cache-only runs to isolate KV effects.

2025-02-24 Ravi Patel: Ran first matrix for small model (7B) across FP16, FP8-opt, INT8-symmetric. Results: steady tokens/sec (8-batch): FP16=12.4k, FP8-opt=11.1k (0.895x), INT8-sym=9.5k (0.77x). p95 long-horizon: FP16=14ms, FP8-opt=18ms, INT8-sym=22ms. Accuracy delta (logprob) median: FP8=0.2%, INT8=0.9%.
2025-02-25 SRE note (Asha Rao): Observed kernel selection variance across driver versions; pinned driver to 525.105.17 for repeatability. Marked as dependency for next runs.

2025-02-27 Ravi Patel: Re-ran calibration seeds (5) for FP8-opt; selected median seed. FP8-opt now shows p95=16ms on long-horizon and accuracy delta 0.18%. Updated thresholds look achievable. Opened PR for results and automation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-harness/pull/134

2025-03-01 Maya Chen: Early draft of CI gating added to bench-harness; config driven thresholds in .benchrc. Need infra owner to add scheduled runners on dedicated pool. Filed infra request: ENG-130208.

2025-03-02 Ravi Patel: Blocker - dedicated pool quota shortfall for repeatable long-horizon runs. Reached out to infra for temporary bump. Also noted INT8 perchannel variant has inconsistent speed on small GPUs; plan to test on larger instances next week.
